description: RockBoard riser family: the Step Up kits and the pedal risers, which lift pedals to a second tier. Dimensions are the unit's overall envelope, length x width x height.

StepUp-2.note: length read off the drawing; width and height are carried over from Step Up 1, which publishes 90 x 145 x 25

StepUp-3.note: length read off the drawing; width and height are carried over from Step Up 1, which publishes 90 x 145 x 25

PedalRiser-L.note: height not legible on the sheet; the 121 callout is the top-plate run, not the envelope

caveats: Step Up kits are angled; height is the rise at the high edge.
Absent or null values are unknown, not zero.

provenance.source: the published spec sheet on https://www.rockboard.de/en/accessories/pedal-riser/ and https://www.rockboard.de/en/accessories/second-tiers/, plus the drawings in ref/stepups
